parsed.note_claim: Persona 3 Reload's water UI theme reflects the original game's design intent evoking water and bubbles, enhanced to symbolize sinking into the Sea of Souls and seaside locations like Port Island.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Ever since the original version, I’ve been impressed by the beautiful blue color and movement reminiscent of water and bubbles. When I talked to the staff who worked on the original game before starting on P3R, I found out that they had actually created the UI with that image in mind.
parsed.reason: The art director confirms the original UI was designed with water and bubbles in mind, and says P3R combines the beauty of the sea from Port Island and Yakushima with the protagonist's "Sea of Souls" and a sinking-into-one's-heart concept.
